## Chemical interpretation

All inputs are simulated teaching data. The dissolved copper checks pass, but they do not validate plant digestion. The method blank is measured undiluted; undo the sample's further dilution before subtracting it on the digest concentration basis. Conditional dry-mass results are 160.3587 and 300.4236 mg Cu/kg. The method blank has no dry-mass result.

## Transfer and limits

The transfer digest is 0.0800 × 5 − 0.0100 = 0.3900 mg/L; result 48.75 mg/kg dry mass. Elemental detection does not preserve molecular identity or original oxidation states. Recovery, mass, volume, calibration and blank variation need attention in a full uncertainty budget.

The complete executable solution is in `R/analyse-atomic-methods.R`. The student lesson
and data dictionary specify the measurand, input units and row meanings. A
conditional teaching result is not full method validation.
